title: RETRACTION: Nature of Property Rights and Motivation for Blue Growth: An Empirical Evidence From the Fisheries Industry
content:
RETRACTION: M. Alsaleh, A. S. Abdul-Rahim, R. Liu, and Q. Sun, “ Nature of Property Rights and Motivation for Blue Growth: An Empirical Evidence From the Fisheries Industry,” Natural Resources Forum 48, no. 1 (2024): 184–210, https://doi.org/10.1111/1477-8947.12317.

The above article, published online on 04 September 2023 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between; the journal Editor-in-Chief, Mohammad Reza Salamat; and John Wiley & Sons Ltd. The retraction has been agreed following an investigation by the publisher. Several flaws and inconsistencies in the results presented and the experimental methods described were found, and the editors consider the conclusions of this article to be invalid.
